description: Get full details of one Anycast CDN resource (pull zone): origin, TTLs, compression, origin shield, domains, locations. Check here whether a feature is on before proposing changes — e.g. image_processing_enabled (+ image_processing_extensions), location_mode ('basic'|'extended'), hls_support_enabled, mpeg_dash_support_enabled, origin_shield_enabled, edge_compression. The same settings are switches in the customer panel at https://client.blazingcdn.com/anycast_cdn/<resource_id>/<tab>.
name: get_cdn_resource
title: Get CDN resource
